scope: Static light objects (Light/DirLight/ObjectLight), the original vertex light term, and replacement per-vertex model shading; no game or renderer code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: The light term color*(1-d/R)*linear cone, without N.L or occlusion, reproduces baked vertex colors within 3: SubwayA 100%, Steam Tunnels 99%, Train Station 99.8%, CityHub 95.5%. Lightmap texels measure 1.0-1.4x the same term with N.L.

references.purpose: Light/DirLight/ObjectLight/GlobalDirLight properties and CF_NORUNTIME; ObjectLight lights only objects, GlobalDirLight only the world.
FLAG_MODELGOURAUDSHADE (Gouraud model shading) and FLAG_NOLIGHT (object color only) definitions.
Later-generation ranking: strongest lights at the object center become device lights, the rest join the ambient.
Later-generation spot evaluation and model light sampling, consulted for the selection policy.
Saturate applies MODULATE2X to Gouraud shading in later LithTech, supporting the doubling of N.L model light.

adaptations: Lambert N.L per model vertex, the four-source limit and ClipLight occlusion at the model center are replacement policies.
N.L model light is doubled like lightmaps; flat and unlit models are not.
